context: November 16 was sideways in all three indices, a little up and a little down. Buyers and sellers are both seated; the sellers are fewer and the buyers more, as the market is very positive. November 17 is NIFTY's expiry.
plan: FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: the buyers did not run on the small rejections, so they cannot be targeted; identify buying-side setups.
GAP DOWN -> SELL: the risk on those buyers rises, so they become the target; identify selling-side setups.
